brief: Ten distinct designs; only architectural layout is locked. Door designs, finishes, lighting and signage may change.

variants.title: Орех и терраццо
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Produce ONE photorealistic editorial architectural photograph of a radically redesigned residential entrance lobby, attractive business-class appearance with straightforward buildable finishes.
IMAGE 1 IS THE EDIT TARGET: preserve its architectural layout STRICTLY. Other input images are inspiration for materials and craft ONLY.
FIXED: same room dimensions, wall planes, wall corner, ceiling elevation, floor level, same exact camera/framing/landscape aspect ratio. The left solid stair door opening remains exactly in its original location and size. The right glazed double-door opening remains exactly in its original location and size. Never move, enlarge, remove or add an opening. Keep the corner between doors fixed and do not straighten/change perspective. Preserve the layout visible through glass or use obscured glass instead of inventing new rooms.
FREE DESIGN: fully redesign door leaves, frames, handles, wall coverings, ceiling finish and lighting fixtures, floor material and laying pattern, skirting, signs and decorative elements. Do NOT merely add a small panel to the old beige render; redesign the entire visual language cohesively. The original orange door, black strip light and wall text design need not remain.
Large wall between doors can host shallow decorative work, signage, a very shallow shelf, or artwork; nothing blocks doors or circulation. No reception desk, sofas across passage, made-up windows, deep niches, stairs, arches that change openings, or people. Any overdoor panel is fixed cladding above the existing opening and has a visible joint at original door height. No expensive monumental sculpture or fanciful construction.
Lighting: natural photographic exposure, nuanced soft shadows, realistic detailed materials, comfortable overall visibility, not a dark cinematic cave or yellow CGI render. Aim for authentic finished construction, not plastic AI gloss. Native full-frame landscape image, no collage or caption border, no watermarks.
Wayfinding: integrate just the exact short Russian labels "ЛЕСТНИЦА" for the left door and "ЛИФТ →" for the right passage into the NEW design; small legible text, no brand names or random pseudo-text.

DESIGN 01: Mid-century architectural warmth. Entire left wall composed as a clean large-module medium WALNUT panel grid with fine black reveals; stair door integrated as a flush walnut leaf with a slim dark pull. A wide pale finely speckled TERRAZZO feature panel occupies the central wall, surrounded by walnut flat panels. Right door redesigned in slender charcoal metal and lightly reeded translucent glass. Pale terrazzo-look tile floor, dark narrow skirting. Ceiling warm ivory with a carefully spaced small cluster of three compact black cylinder pendants close to the central wall, plus discreet downlights. Tiny dark wayfinding on terrazzo. Substantial balanced material composition, no glowing vertical strips.

DESIGN 02: Airy Scandinavian/Japandi residential calm, much lighter than a walnut lobby. Blonde oak door leaf and broad very simple oak portal, softly textured ivory linen-like washable wallcovering on the middle wall. A broad shallow OAK CEILING FINISH BAND extends from above stair door towards center without changing ceiling height; recessed tiny downlights in band, one warm opal round wall light on central wall. Pale sand porcelain floor in square modules. Right door with warm light bronze thin frame and clear glass. One restrained framed abstract artwork and a very shallow oak floating ledge beneath on center wall, no floor furniture. Small brown wayfinding plaques. Diffuse daylight quality, tactile and quiet.
